answer: Simultaneous ceremonies stop clones. Each agent books a ridge station and locks a 40-credit bond. Every station fires its beacon pulse inside one 30-second window; the summit relay confirms each pulse against its key. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 stations: 12 setup plus 40 bond each, 52,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented key signing twice burns both bonds. An honest agent pays 52 once and keeps its bond after two clean ceremonies.
